messages:
maria: noticing apiserver read p95 climbing sharply in eu-west1 since 07:42 UTC. controller-manager lease renewals throwing 503s and GPU provisioner pods stuck in Pending. alerts: apiserver_read_latency_p95 > 600ms, controller_lease_failures up 12x.

 tom: seeing same. dashboards show etcd disk io wait spike and increased leader CPU during the window. Not many leader elections but heavy read fanout. GPU attach requests pile up.

 maria: pulled nvme stats from a node: `iostat -x -d /dev/nvme0n1 1 3` -> %util ~99.8, await ~120ms, avgqu-sz high. Also cloud network shows NAT port exhaustion events in the same AZ.

 kevin: NAT exhaustion can cause client retry storms to apiserver if nodes can't open new outbound connections. Nodes end up retrying and increasing apiserver concurrent reads. Could be contributing to the read tail.

 anya: saw something odd on a few nodes after the kernel bump last night. WireGuard tunnels had MTU mismatches, causing fragmentation and retransmits over the tunnel; gRPC endpoints to etcd/apiserver saw more retransmits and CPU. Rolling back kernel on one node dropped p95 there.

 maria: immediate mitigations we rolled: 1) lowered WireGuard MTU to 1400 and set `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on eu-west1 node pool; 2) requested cloud to add ephemeral NAT IPs to the AZ to relieve SNAT pressure; 3) bumped controller-manager lease renewDeadline from 15s -> 30s as temporary safety net.

 jen: opened ticket with cloud support (ticket-54321). They confirm SNAT port exhaustion from a sudden surge of short-lived connections during model pod start-up. They're enabling NAT pool autoscaling and looking at reuse heuristics.

 tom: also changed GPU provisioner to reuse long-lived connections to apiserver (keep-alive) and added client-side backoff on attach loops + prefix caching for list/watch. After the changes p95 read dropped from ~600ms -> ~120ms on the test subset.

 maria: good. rolling the node-level MTU + keepalive change to 90% of eu-west1 nodes, monitoring next 30m. Next steps for postmortem: nvme firmware/health check, kernel rollout plan and MTU defaults, NAT scaling policy, and making provisioner connection patterns resilient.

 kevin: also want an action: add apiserver connection reuse telemetry and SNAT port metrics into the controlplane dashboard so we see breaking points earlier.

 sre-oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-042 and assigned to eng-sre. Link: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042>
